pages.title: Winter break, rest first
pages.note: Rest is the main job of this break. Everything else is optional and small. Check with your school about anything due over break, and fill in only what you actually want to do!

items: Check if anything is due over break (school email, syllabus)
Write down where you'll pick up in January
Lower Anki new cards to zero (or close to it)
Clear your desk and pack light: no textbook pile!
Sleep in at least a few days, on purpose
People I want to see:
Something fun I've been putting off:
One day with zero medicine at all

sections.h: Light upkeep (only if you want it)
items: Anki reviews: a short session most days, or my plan:
Days I'll skip completely (that's okay!):
A walk outside most days
Call someone I haven't talked to in a while
A favorite meal, cooked or ordered
A movie, book or game just for fun
Doctor, dentist or eye appointments while home
Fix one annoying thing (laptop, bike, apartment)
Restock basics for January

sections.h: The last 2-3 days: ease back in
items: Bump Anki back up slowly, a few days early
Look at the first week of next block's schedule
Set out January's first study task
Reset your sleep schedule a little each day

sections.h: One thing I'm proud of from this semester

pins.headline: Med school winter break, rest first
